upstream_service: AWS MCP Server, reached through the security account's AgentCore Gateway

excluded_tools.aws___get_presigned_url: Issues pre-signed Amazon S3 URLs for upload and download. A pre-signed upload URL is a write capability, so it is outside this read-only boundary.

notes: These are the AWS MCP Server's own tool names, and they are what the client sees. The server already namespaces its tools with aws___.

The wire action is two levels deeper: the security account's gateway prefixes its own target name (aws) on top of the server's namespace, and the Hermes gateway adds a third. So the action is aws___aws___aws___<tool> -- declared here as gateway_action_prefix plus these names, never baked into the names themselves.

Keeping the nesting in gateway_action_prefix is deliberate: the alternative leaks the number of gateways in the path into every tool name the client sees, and makes those names change again if a hop is ever added or removed.
Read-only is enforced by IAM on the security gateway's execution role, not by the tool set: aws___run_script inherits that role's permissions and cannot exceed them.
aws___run_script is the AWS API execution tool in the current server tool list; there is no separate call_aws tool.
